Hypothesis to revise: TITLE: Episode-free log-odds fusion: conformal few-shot evidence and calibrated zero-shot probability weighted by support reliability
SUMMARY: Fuse the temperature-calibrated zero-shot probability and the conformal few-shot p-value in log-odds with weights set from the target supports themselves (inverse leave-one-out variance of each branch), removing the dependence on source episodes for the fusion.
HYPOTHESIS: Support-reliability weights match source-episode-fitted fusion weights within 0.5 image-AUROC points on held-out modalities while eliminating the episode-fitting step, and the fused score keeps the realised false-positive rate within 2 points of the nominal 5% at K >= 4.
RATIONALE: The log-odds parent and the conformal parent both need source episodes to fit fusion weights, which assumes that the relative reliability of the two branches transfers across modalities, the very assumption a leave-one-modality-out evaluation questions. Their combination can keep the calibrated zero-shot probability and the conformal few-shot p-value while estimating branch reliability on the target: a branch whose leave-one-out scores on the support normals vary less is more reliable for this modality. Inverse-variance weighting is the standard estimator for combining noisy evidence and needs no abnormal data.
METHOD: 1) Zero-shot: p0 with source-fitted temperature (unchanged). 2) Few-shot: conformal p from LOO support scores. 3) On the K supports, compute LOO logits l0_i = logit(p0_i) and l1_i = logit(1 - p_i) (with p_i from the remaining supports); weights w_b = 1/Var_i(l_b,i), normalised to sum 2. 4) Fused logit z = w0 logit(p0) + w1 logit(1 - p) - median_i(w0 l0_i + w1 l1_i) (centres support normals at 0). 5) Threshold at the 95th percentile of support LOO fused scores. 6) test_few.py: implement; remove min-max. No adapter training.
EXPERIMENT: Leave-one-modality-out on BMAD (RESC and OCT17 held out together), MVFA retrained with source-validation selection; K in {2,4,8,16}; 3 seeds x 3 support draws. Baselines: transductive MVFA pipeline, support z-score. Conditions: equal weights; support-reliability weights; source-episode weights (reference). Metrics: image AUROC, realised FPR at the support threshold, ECE, score shift under resampling. Falsified if support weights lose more than 0.5 AUROC points relative to episode weights or realised FPR exceeds 7%.
